Name: Mopsy's Ranch Livin'
Author: mpql
Description:
Trying to live on Lon Lon Ranch, but Lon Lon Farm doesn't have the same ring to it? I've got your back. This mod lets you choose your own custom farm name suffix, and it defaults to Ranch!

First of all, you need SMAPI. I assume if you're on this site that you already know how to install/use SMAPI, but you can head to [url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io/[/url] if not.

[b]Install[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of Mopsy's Ranch Livin' from the [b]Files[/b] section.
[*]Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI!
[/list]
[b]Configure[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Load up a save file. If you want your suffix to be "Ranch", you're already done!
[*]If you want it to be something other than "Ranch", run the command `farm_setsuffix Ranch` in the SMAPI command prompt, where "Ranch" is something else. Don't make it too long or it'll look dumb in some places.

[/list]
That's it! Running that command saves it to a per-save config file, so whenever you load up a save, it'll remember which suffix you last used for that save! You can find this config file in your Saves folder, and you can also edit it manually!

Suffixes are limited to 10 characters to avoid silly things, but still don't make it too long/wide, or it might look dumb in some places.
 
Romani Ranch, here I come! ;D

[b]Notes[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Tested with Stardew Valley 1.3.36 and SMAPI 2.11.2.[/i]
[*]Right now, this is only for English. I don't speak any other languages well enough to translate this. If anyone else would like to muck around the various strings/dialogues/events and create translations, let me know. If the keys are not different, I just need the word I need to replace, and with what, and if they keys are also translated, I'd need the files/keys as well.
[*]You can find my source for this mod [url=https://github.com/mopquill/Mopsys-Ranch-Livin]on Github[/url]﻿.
[/list]
